description: Foundation layer: extract StatusBadge component, extend TypeScript types, write all 4 SQL migration files, add print CSS, update Sidebar and Layout. These are shared prerequisites for FEAT-P2-002 and FEAT-P2-003. All steps here are independent of each other (no inter-step dependencies), but all must complete before FEAT-P2-002 begins.
steps: Create src/components/StatusBadge.tsx. Props: { status: string; colorMap?: Record }. Default colorMap covers ProjectStatus values: Pending='bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800', 'In Progress'='bg-blue-100 text-blue-800', Completed='bg-green-100 text-green-800', 'On Hold'='bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'. For unknown statuses fall back to 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500'. Renders: {status}
Update src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: remove the inline StatusBadge function (lines ~17-26), add import StatusBadge from '../components/StatusBadge' at top. No other changes to this file yet.
Update src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx: remove the inline StatusBadge function (lines ~20-29), add import StatusBadge from '../components/StatusBadge' at top. No other changes to this file.

Extend src/types/index.ts — append after the existing Project interface: (a) export type ProposalStatus = 'Draft' | 'Sent' | 'Accepted' | 'Changes Requested' | 'Rejected'; (b) export type ProposalResponseAction = 'Accepted' | 'Changes Requested' | 'Rejected'; (c) export interface ProposalItem { id: string; description: string; quantity: number; unit_price: number; subtotal: number; } (d) export interface Proposal { id: string; client_id: string; title: string; introduction?: string; deliverables?: string; terms?: string; items: ProposalItem[]; total_amount: number; currency: string; expiry_date?: string; status: ProposalStatus; portal_token: string; created_at: string; updated_at: string; client?: Client; } (e) export interface ProposalResponse { id: string; proposal_id: string; action: ProposalResponseAction; comment?: string; responded_at: string; } (f) export interface ContractContent { client_name: string; client_company: string; client_email: string; proposal_title: string; items: ProposalItem[]; total_amount: number; currency: string; deliverables?: string; terms?: string; issued_at: string; } (g) export interface Contract { id: string; proposal_id: string; client_id: string; content: ContractContent; status: 'Draft' | 'Active'; created_at: string; updated_at: string; }

Create src/db/migrations/003_create_agency_proposals.sql. Header comment: Migration 003, run after 002. Table agency_proposals: id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PK, client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES agency_clients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, title text NOT NULL, introduction text, deliverables text, terms text, items jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, total_amount numeric(14,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, currency text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ETB', expiry_date date, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Draft' CHECK (status IN ('Draft','Sent','Accepted','Changes Requested','Rejected')), portal_token text NOT NULL UNIQUE DEFAULT encode(gen_random_bytes(32),'hex'), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). Indexes: agency_proposals_client_id_idx, agency_proposals_status_idx, agency_proposals_portal_token_idx. RLS: ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Four policies checking auth.uid() = '9705a671-4d69-49bb-b5f9-7f69cad4f0f8'::uuid (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE). Trigger: agency_proposals_updated_at using existing agency_handle_updated_at().

Create src/db/migrations/004_create_agency_proposal_responses.sql. Header comment: Migration 004, run after 003. Table agency_proposal_responses: id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PK, proposal_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES agency_proposals(id) ON DELETE CASCADE UNIQUE, action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('Accepted','Changes Requested','Rejected')), comment text, responded_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). The UNIQUE constraint on proposal_id enforces one response per proposal at DB level. RLS: ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Admin SELECT policy: auth.uid() = '9705a671-4d69-49bb-b5f9-7f69cad4f0f8'::uuid. No direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies for any role — all writes go through the security-definer RPC in migration 006.

Create src/db/migrations/005_create_agency_contracts.sql. Header comment: Migration 005, run after 004. Table agency_contracts: id uuid DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PK, proposal_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES agency_proposals(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT UNIQUE, client_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES agency_clients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, content jsonb NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Draft' CHECK (status IN ('Draft','Active')), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). Indexes: agency_contracts_client_id_idx, agency_contracts_proposal_id_idx. RLS: ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY. Four admin-only policies. Trigger reusing agency_handle_updated_at().

Create src/db/migrations/006_portal_functions.sql. Header comment: Migration 006, run after 005. Two SECURITY DEFINER functions with SET search_path = public, pg_temp. Function 1: get_portal_data(p_token text) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql — fetches proposal by portal_token where status != 'Draft', returns null if not found or Draft. Joins client (id, name, company, email only), response (if any), contract content (if any), project (title, status, description, start_date, deadline — via client_id). Returns structured JSONB. After CREATE: REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_portal_data(text) FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.get_portal_data(text) TO anon, authenticated;  Function 2: submit_proposal_response(p_token text, p_action text, p_comment text) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql — validates token exists and status='Sent', validates action IN ('Accepted','Changes Requested','Rejected'), checks no existing response, inserts into agency_proposal_responses, updates agency_proposals.status to p_action, returns '{"success": true}'. On any validation failure returns '{"error": "..."}' without raising an exception. After CREATE: REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.submit_proposal_response(text,text,text) FROM PUBLIC; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION public.submit_proposal_response(text,text,text) TO anon, authenticated;

Update src/components/Sidebar.tsx: add FileText to the lucide-react import. Add { to: '/proposals', label: 'Proposals', icon: FileText, end: false } to the navItems array between the Projects entry and before Sign Out (navItems is used to render nav links; Sign Out is a separate button below).

Update src/components/Layout.tsx: (a) add entries to PAGE_TITLES: '/proposals': 'Proposals', '/proposals/new': 'New Proposal'. (b) Add className='no-print' to the <Sidebar> component usage and to the <header> element (the Header component wrapper). In Layout.tsx, Sidebar is rendered as <Sidebar isOpen={sidebarOpen} onClose={...} /> — wrap it with a div with no-print class OR add no-print to the aside element in Sidebar.tsx itself. The cleanest approach: in Sidebar.tsx add 'no-print' to the existing className array on the <aside> element. In Layout.tsx add 'no-print' to the <Header> component by wrapping it: wrap <Header ... /> in a div with className='no-print'. This ensures all admin-page print output hides nav chrome.
Append print CSS to src/index.css: add after the existing @tailwind utilities line: @media print { .no-print { display: none !important; } body { background: white !important; } }
